question: Should existing GitHub-backed skills with over-limit stored display names be grandfathered like hosted skills, or intentionally renamed on the next sync?
rationale: The PR chooses different legacy behavior for hosted publish and GitHub-backed sync, and that compatibility policy cannot be inferred safely from the issue text alone.

options.title: Grandfather GitHub-backed legacy names
options.body: Preserve unchanged existing over-limit GitHub-backed display names while enforcing the limit for new or renamed GitHub-backed titles.

options.title: Accept sync renames as migration
options.body: Treat the next sync rename as intentional product policy, but document it and add focused tests/proof for that migration behavior.

options.title: Pause for policy confirmation
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers confirm the exact display-name maximum and legacy handling in the linked issue or PR discussion.

recommendation.title: Grandfather GitHub-backed legacy names
recommendation.body: Preserve unchanged existing over-limit GitHub-backed display names while enforcing the limit for new or renamed GitHub-backed titles.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen authored the GitHub-backed sync feature and is the strongest history owner for the sync compatibility choice.
